permissionBoundary: Existing readOnly, ask and full action modes remain enforced. Ordinary visual verification does not bypass them. No verification API bypass, token forging, app modification or secret collection was added.
gestureLifetime: One pointer per native thread and turn; cancellation, completion and shutdown invalidate ownership; 15 seconds of inactivity cancels the held pointer.
